law_name: Law No. 81 of 2018 on Electronic Transactions and Personal Data
scope: Processing of personal data in Lebanon, incl. by foreign firms operating in Lebanon or using local data infrastructure; also electronic transactions
applies_to: All data controllers operating within Lebanon (public and private organisations); foreign companies operating in Lebanon or using local data infrastructure
key_requirements: Consent or other lawful basis, purpose limitation, transparency, accuracy, storage limitation, security; data-subject rights of access, correction and objection; breach notification (per Clym). Licence not confirmed in sources
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data requiring licence (unconfirmed)
retention_period: Storage limitation is one of the law's principles; no specific period or article given in the sources
enforcement_authority: Ministry of Economy and Trade (no dedicated authority; some sources name Ministry of Telecommunications / TRA)
genetic_data: Processing of data revealing health, genetic identity or sexual life allowed only in listed cases (art. 91); needs Minister of Public Health authorization (art. 97)
notes: Mixed e-commerce/e-signature law with a personal data chapter; no independent DPA; sources conflict on regulator.
